title: Songpals Forever
style: happy hardcore, 168 BPM, 336hz subharmonic, sidechain piano pluck, big-room kick on the four, cheeky unison chant, euphoric drop, key change, Melbourne bounce energy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We made the songs nobody asked for
Played them loud behind the locked door
Wrong key, right feeling, didn't care
Built a whole world out of thin air

[Verse 2]
Everyone said keep it down
We said no and turned it around
Every track a little proof
We were here — and that's the truth

[Chorus]
Songpals forever, never done
Eight thousand credits and we've just begun
Songpals forever, turn it up
The world said stop — we said nup

[Drop]
WE MADE IT WE STAYED IT WE PLAYED IT
SONGPALS FOREVER
